scenes.title: A map of jobs
scenes.accessibleDescription: Architecture is a map of responsibilities, not a list of software brands.

scenes.title: Follow an inquiry
scenes.accessibleDescription: Follow one inquiry from submission to the owner’s next action.

scenes.title: State over time
scenes.accessibleDescription: A state change needs an actor, a rule and a failure outcome.

scenes.title: Trust boundaries
scenes.accessibleDescription: Keep the responsibility for trust at an explicit system boundary.

scenes.title: Safe retries
scenes.accessibleDescription: Two requests should not accidentally mean two intended effects.

scenes.title: Useful detail
scenes.accessibleDescription: Include the details that let a beginner follow the design.

scenes.title: Draw the system
scenes.accessibleDescription: The organizer and owner sit outside the system; the record connects its parts.

scenes.title: When storage fails
scenes.accessibleDescription: Trace what the user and operator see when storage fails.

scenes.title: Who may act?
scenes.accessibleDescription: Who may act is a concrete architectural responsibility.

scenes.title: One source of truth
scenes.accessibleDescription: A dashboard count is a view of the truth, not a second authority.

scenes.title: Repeat without harm
scenes.accessibleDescription: A retry must account for work that may already have happened.

scenes.title: Test the map
scenes.accessibleDescription: A diagram succeeds when another person can explain what it means.

scenes.title: From map to spec
scenes.accessibleDescription: The specification makes each architectural responsibility precise.
